tools.name: find_products
tools.description:
Discover candidate products for a buyer need. Takes a need in natural language (e.g. "best value home espresso machine", market "TH"), checks the verified catalog first, then uses live web discovery only when the catalog has no candidates. Returns up to 3 candidates with explicit fit accounting.

tools.name: research_shopping
tools.description: research_shopping is the full verified-research job; find_products is the quick candidate-list tool. It runs as a background job and returns status "running" with a research ID while the minutes-long research continues; the same research ID returns the run on later polls until completion. tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Get the full golden record (AirShelf's verified product record) and latest price for one catalog product by slug ("<manufacturer>-<model>").

Returns the product's specs and provenance (which page each fact came from), plus canonical_name (its exact catalog name). Branch on commercial_data.actionabl

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description:
Compare 2-10 catalog products side-by-side on their datasheet specs. Slugs come from search_catalog and are case-insensitive and dash-tolerant ("e-STUDIO 331AC", "toshiba-e-studio-331ac" and "e-studio331ac" all resolve to the same product).

tools.name: explain_product
tools.description: Explain the evidence behind a catalog row. Returns stored processing stages when available and always returns a golden-record field summary with source coverage.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List public AirShelf merchants that have an assigned slug and at least one active product. Internal/demo and empty catalogs are excluded. Returns each merchant's name, slug, and product count; the slug is the `merchant` argument for request_quote.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, find_products, get_product, request_quote · Private data: search_catalog, get_product, compare_products, explain_product, request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: search_catalog, find_products, research_shopping.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, find_products, get_product, request_quote · Private data: search_catalog, get_product, compare_products, explain_product, request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: search_catalog, find_products, research_shopping

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
